title: Milk, Cheese, Juice, and Soup
label: ch:russian-milk-cheese-juice-soup
canDo: I can name milk, cheese, juice and soup in Russian with their genders, ask for any of them politely, and say which are inherited and which are borrowed.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on суп, a French loan that mirrors кофе's story from the opposite direction: the reader produces молоко, сыр, сок and суп with their genders, extends Chapter 6's request pattern to all four, and sorts the set into a hand-motion cousin, a taste cousin, an honest dead end, and a shared loanword. It reaches all the way back to Chapter 2 to rescue the naming-question comparison and я's script warning, the last two atoms in the track that nothing had revisited.
